parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. The shared name `MockArtworkService` in both files is a classic test-fixture pattern — mock objects are intentionally duplicated per test suite to keep each suite self-contained and to avoid coupling unrelated test packages through a shared mock. Consolidating these mocks would couple the `AppServices` test target to the `Artwork` test target (or vice versa), which is an anti-pattern for test isolation. No structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, differing_slots) was surfaced in the cluster row to further motivate action.
